evidence: PDF p.132 (printed p.108): "[1P][FACT]: 8×H100 GPUs provide 8 × 80 GB = 640 GB aggregate HBM memory (real hardware spec)." issue: Evidence-label/provenance mismatch: the 640 GB aggregate is tagged [1P][FACT] with the gloss "real hardware spec", promoting a scenario deployment-unit composite (scenario 8-GPU count × vendor 80 GB constant) to the strongest first-party label, in direct violation of the book's own composite-cell rule and inconsistent with the labeling of the same quantity in Ch 4 and Ch 7.
